blogs.title: Welcome to WTS CMS
blogs.excerpt: A guided tour of the Webskitters-powered CMS starter and the problems it solves.
blogs.content:
Platform context

A guided tour of the Webskitters-powered CMS starter and the problems it solves. WTS CMS keeps the core stack simple: Express, MongoDB, Next.js, strict TypeScript, and a reusable admin experience.

For Webskitters teams, this means faster project starts, fewer repeated setup decisions, and a consistent pattern for SEO, security, media, redirects, and roles.

Webskitters workflow

The recommended workflow is to model the content first, assign the right RBAC permissions, prepare SEO metadata, review public rendering, and then publish with confidence.

  • Keep URLs lowercase, descriptive, and redirect-safe.
  • Write one editable H1 and use H2/H3 sections in content.
  • Add image alt text and schema when the page deserves rich search context.
Powered by Webskitters Technology Solutions Pvt. Ltd. This demo article is ready to edit from the WTS CMS admin.

snapshot.content:
Platform context

Use WTS CMS redirects to protect rankings when published URLs change. WTS CMS keeps the core stack simple: Express, MongoDB, Next.js, strict TypeScript, and a reusable admin experience.

For Webskitters teams, this means faster project starts, fewer repeated setup decisions, and a consistent pattern for SEO, security, media, redirects, and roles.

Webskitters workflow

The recommended workflow is to model the content first, assign the right RBAC permissions, prepare SEO metadata, review public rendering, and then publish with confidence.

  • Keep URLs lowercase, descriptive, and redirect-safe.
  • Write one editable H1 and use H2/H3 sections in content.
  • Add image alt text and schema when the page deserves rich search context.
